FlowiseAI/Flowise.note: Officially sunset: 3.1.4 released 2026-07-29, feature freeze 2026-07-27, GitHub archive 2026-08-10, EOL 2026-08-31. Keep temporarily as transition/reference material, not as a newly maintained dependency. Re-review for a maintained community fork after EOL.

Stability-AI/StableLM.note: Last push 2024-04-08 -- roughly 870 days at time of adding, far past the 365d removal threshold. Added deliberately as a historical reference: StableLM was a landmark 2024 open-weight release and the repo is useful for understanding that generation. It is NOT a current runtime choice; for local inference today use the Gemma / Phi / Ollama lanes in repo-lists/local-models.txt. Re-review only if Stability resumes development.

YuhaoLin2005/compact-counter-concept.note: Archived MIT research utility, 0 stars. Small enough to absorb outright if the measurement approach is still wanted -- see docs/MANAGED-ADOPTION-PLAN.md. Otherwise reference-only.

ZongqianLi/Prompt-Compression-Survey.note: Static academic survey/reference repository. No repository license was detected, so do not fork or copy code/content into a managed replacement without explicit permission.

bradygaster/MultiAgent.note: Microsoft dev-advocate conference demo, point-in-time by construction. Reference only; do not depend on it. For real agent work use microsoft/agent-framework.

bradygaster/Squad-IRL.note: Microsoft dev-advocate demo project. Reference only.

bradygaster/dotnet-cloud-native-build-20.note: Build 2023 conference demo. Pinned to that event; reference only.

bukosabino/ta.note: Technical-analysis indicator maths (5,180 stars). The formulas do not change; quiet is correct.

coinbase/cdp-sdk-python.note: Superseded 2026-08-25 by the coinbase/cdp-sdk monorepo (pushed 2026-08-25). Kept for existing Python integrations; prefer coinbase/cdp-sdk for new work.

facebookresearch/vjepa2.note: Meta research release. Finished artifact rather than a maintained runtime package.

langchain-ai/open_deep_research.note: Archived 2026-08-10. MIT-licensed, so managed adoption IS legally permitted. Queued as the highest-value adoption candidate -- see docs/MANAGED-ADOPTION-PLAN.md. Until adoption completes, treat as reference: the technique is worth reading, the repo is not maintained. Continuation work upstream lives in langchain-ai/langgraph.

microsoft/LLMLingua.note: Still the reference prompt-compression implementation with a published paper behind it. Reference-grade rather than fast-moving.

microsoft/autogen.note: Superseded 2026-08-25 by microsoft/agent-framework (the announced AutoGen + Semantic Kernel merger). Evidence: AutoGen last release python-v0.7.5 on 2025-09-30; agent-framework released dotnet-1.19.0 on 2026-08-22 and ships roughly weekly. Existing AutoGen code is not broken and needs no emergency migration; start new work on agent-framework. See docs/ADK-GUIDE.md.

microsoft/lets-learn-mcp-python.note: Official Microsoft course material pinned to a teaching moment. Not intended to track MCP spec changes.

passiv/snaptrade-react.note: Official vendor SDK for a stable API. Low churn is expected rather than a warning sign.

qiskit-community/ibm-quantum-challenge-f.note: Historical IBM Quantum Challenge material. Static by design; keep only as an educational/reference artifact rather than an active runtime dependency.

rmurai0610/MASt3R-SLAM.note: Paper-code for a published SLAM method (3,166 stars). Research artifacts are finished, not stale; age is the wrong metric.

rpng/open_vins.note: Mature, widely-cited visual-inertial odometry library. Stability is the feature; low churn is expected.

vision-x-nyu/thinking-in-space.note: Official VSI-Bench research/evaluation artifact. Treat research artifacts separately from runtime packages; keep as reference while still relevant to spatial reasoning evaluation.

wentaoyuan/RoboPoint.note: Apache-2.0 research artifact for spatial affordance prediction. Keep as reference while still relevant; do not interpret paper-code quietness as runtime-package abandonment.
